text:
Captain

 Command a fleet of AI agents — on every deck, every desk, every wrist

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 Most AI tools give you one agent in a chat box. Captain Flight Deck is a multi-agent command center: spawn specialist teams, run seven orchestration modes , ship software with Code (plan → build → independent review), and compose deterministic Flows . Self-hosted, MIT licensed, and it works with every major LLM provider, or 100% local with Ollama. Since 0.8.2 your Flight Decks work together : a planner on your VPS asks a researcher on the Raspberry Pi at home, and you watch the request cross a live map. Your team works from a kiosk ; you can just talk to a watch . Since 0.8.4 you can teach an agent your work and test it , and see every task on one Taskboard . Since 0.8.5 your agents run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Crush and Pi as their crew , and you can say what you need and get a whole team , with its schedules and its software. Since 0.8.6 everything they do on their own is on one Line , Captain Swarm makes them measurably better at your real work, and Captain for your desktop is a 75 MB download that updates itself. Since 0.8.8 they see what you see: Captain for Chrome sends the page you're on, and Captain for Mac sends what's on your screen from any app. Since 0.9.1 your private data stays yours: anonymization turns names, companies and numbers into tokens before a model sees them and puts them back when the answer comes home, and data rooms let Claude read a whole deal's files without learning who is in them.

 🌐 Website · 🚀 Live Demo · 📖 Docs · ▶️ YouTube · 📦 PyPI · 🧭 Guides · 📝 What's new 

 New in 0.9.1 — Strongroom: anonymization with an encrypted vault per case and a privacy gate for your agents; data rooms that give Claude a deal's files without the names and bring its results back restored; Vatra, Basna and Council in the kiosk; a new kiosk home; agents in your own Chrome. Release notes · 0.9.0 — Shipyard: tools of your own, built by Crew and run by Flight Deck in a sandbox; agents in one .captain file to back up, move or hand on; agents that hand each other work, answer email meant for them, read any IMAP inbox, learn from corrections you approve and know the goals their work is for. Release notes · 0.8.11 — Hold: a message written while the agent is busy waits and goes when it's free. Release notes · 0.8.10 — Provisions: pick a provider, paste its key, and every model tier is set; scans read by a local OCR engine with no model; a working turn no longer stops at 40 steps. Release notes · 0.8.8 — Spyglass: Captain for Chrome sends the page you're on to one of your agents, Captain for Mac sends what's on your screen from any app (hold fn, or click), and a round of fixes from watching real users. Release notes · 0.8.9 makes agents work in the Windows desktop app, and a downloaded Mac app no longer "damaged": notes · Earlier: 0.8.7 · 0.8.6 — Ship's Log 

 Flight Decks that work together  ·  Captain for Chrome and for Mac  ·  custom tools Crew builds for your agents  ·  anonymization and data rooms for Claude  ·  7 orchestration modes  ·  81 built-in tools per agent  ·  6 shared memory layers  ·  131 ready-made archetypes  ·  a full coding pipeline  ·  Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Crush and Pi as your crew  ·  a team-safe deck and kiosk  ·  voice devices from M5Stack and Waveshare  ·  living beings you raise  ·  small models that do real work 

 Why Captain

- 🛸 A fleet, not a chatbot. Spawn specialists from 131 ready-made archetypes (31 generalists and 100 specialists, for your industry or your own life) plus the ones your admin generates for your company, describe a goal and let Agent Forge design the whole team, or say what you need in your own words and Forge agents plans a standing team with its schedules and its software.
- 🎓 Agents you can train. Give an agent your documents and it keeps them whole at no token cost, reads what you budget for, and learns rules and facts you review. Then exam it, and see exactly where it went wrong It drafts lessons from your corrections for you to approve, works toward the goals you set on its Course , and fits in one file to back up, move to another deck or hand to a client.
- 🧩 The right shape for every problem. Seven orchestration modes, from blind ensembles merged by learned reliability to a collaborative blackboard, moderated councils, and a finisher that stops only when an independent judge says the work is done.
- 🛰️ Decks that work together. Flight Decks on a VPS, a laptop and a Raspberry Pi behind home NAT lend each other their agents over BotPort , and you watch every request cross a live map.
- 💻 An engineering department. Plan → your approval → build → three independent reviewers → fix, every phase a git commit in your own repo. Or hand the work to Crew : Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Crush and Pi in worktrees of their own, several at once, and nothing lands until a person says so. Crew also builds custom tools , small Python programs Flight Deck runs for your agents, sandboxed on Linux.
- 👥 Ready for a team. A kiosk your non-admins live in, an admin console, invitations by email, per-user Google and Microsoft accounts, shared agents, daily plan limits or people's own AI keys, agents held to their own files, and a deck that updates itself from the console.
- 🔌 Plugs into anything. Give your CRM, shop or monitoring its own key and it talks to an agent over a WebSocket, HTTP or signed webhooks, or Flight Deck dials out to it. MCP works both ways: Claude drives your fleet, and your agents use any MCP server.
- 📡 Wherever you are. Web, WhatsApp (the Cloud API, or your own number), Telegram, a HUD for Meta Ray-Ban Display, push-to-talk devices from M5Stack and Waveshare, and Claude itself over MCP, all one conversation.

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
pip install captain-claw
flight-deck          # the multi-agent dashboard: http://localhost:25080

First run starts onboarding. For a single agent in the terminal or the browser, Docker, a deck for your team or a voice device, see Getting started.
